responsibility: Provides the main ELF/System V.4 target configuration layer for rs6000 PowerPC. It selects the ELF object format and SysV-style ABI defaults, defines extensive option-override logic for ABI names, small-data models, relocatable and PIC compatibility, TOC and endian behavior, and installs the large driver spec framework for OS-specific CPP, startup, endfile, link, secure-PLT, profiling, exception-format, and include-path policy used by the many ELF subtargets that build on it.
same_name_distinction: This is the SysV4/ELF target-configuration header, setting ELF object-format policy, ABI selection logic, driver specs, relocation rules, and OS-specific defaults for rs6000 ELF targets. Unlike sysv4.opt, it implements the configuration and override machinery rather than declaring the option entries.
